problems.quote: Polynuclear aromatics (naphthalene, anthracene) show increased reactivity at the α‑positions.
problems.problem: Anthracene undergoes electrophilic substitution preferentially at the 9,10-positions (meso positions), not the α-positions.
problems.correction: Polynuclear aromatics like naphthalene show increased reactivity at the α‑positions; anthracene reacts at the 9,10-positions.
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly groups anthracene with naphthalene; anthracene electrophilic substitution occurs at 9,10-positions, not α-positions.

problems.problem: Missing inequality symbols < and > in the list; shows commas and spaces instead
problems.verifierReason: Original quote shows malformed list missing < and > symbols; correction properly lists all four relational operators.

problems.quote: have a constitutional mandate under Articles 151 and 324
problems.problem: Article 324 pertains to the Election Commission, not financial committees; financial committees derive authority from parliamentary rules, not Article 324.
problems.correction: operate under parliamentary rules to scrutinise CAG reports
problems.verifierReason: Article 324 governs Election Commission; financial committees derive authority from parliamentary rules, not Constitution.

problems.problem: Quorum for GST Council meetings is half the total number of members, not half the total voting weight.
problems.verifierReason: Quorum is half of total members per Art. 279A(7), not voting weight. Correction accurate.

problems.problem: Karnataka Lokayukta was established in 1984 (Act passed in 1984), not 1979.
problems.verifierReason: Karnataka Lokayukta Act enacted in 1984, not 1979. Correction correct.

problems.problem: Delhi Lokayukta was established in 1995 under the Delhi Lokayukta Act, 1995.
problems.verifierReason: Delhi Lokayukta established under Delhi Lokayukta Act, 1995. Correction correct.

problems.quote: The 2020 amendment to the Lokpal Act expanded the definition of “public servant”
problems.problem: There was no 2020 amendment; the Lokpal Act was amended in 2016, and the described changes are inaccurate.
problems.correction: The 2016 amendment to the Lokpal Act modified certain provisions
problems.verifierReason: No 2020 amendment; 2016 amendment modified provisions. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: states’ obligation to enact Lokayukta laws under Article 253
problems.problem: Article 253 deals with legislation for implementing international agreements; the obligation comes from the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 (passed under Article 252).
problems.correction: states’ obligation to enact Lokayukta laws under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013
problems.verifierReason: Obligation stems from Lokpal Act 2013 (passed under Art. 252), not Art. 253. Correction accurate.
